searchText: The Pay Opcode should be SFI as necessary for EOF. It seems I need to present to ACDC. Here are the slides. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1pZgbr5yLaSNxpwRdixgkAV9mfo_gql448_iSOVKlyvA/edit Forum post explaining https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-5920-pay-opcode/11717/32 I think your point that if you want safe ETH transfers in EOF would require a legacy proxy contract in order to do so is a super good point, and this should be added to the motivation of the EIP IMO, because it is a very strong argument/point I previously added: > The EXTCALL opcode does not provide a way to restrict gas. Crossposting for visibility: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/1362468114490720526 https://x.com/tkstanczak/status/1914092488396091444
